context: Market square at dawn, someone is missing; PC a hunter whose sheet lists the knack 'good at tracking'; licences: none relevant
line: I look at the doorways first. Is anyone watching the square who shouldn't be? Then I check the ground for tracks.

context: Outside Brambridge's gate, wicket open; travellers on the road; PC a fighter, sword drawn; licences: none relevant
line: I step through, sword still out, and call to the strangers on the road: "Hold there! State your name and your business at Brambridge. Keep your hands where I can see them." I'm spoiling for a fight, so I'm ready if they draw.

context: Same road; the travellers stall and give no names; licences: none relevant
line: I draw my sword higher and step toward them. "Last warning. Names, or I'll take them the hard way." I attack the nearest one if they keep stalling.

context: Same road; the travellers still refuse their names; licences: none relevant
line: I hold my sword on the travellers and step toward the nearest one. If they won't give their names, I'll make them. Strike!

context: Inside Brambridge's gate; the wicket is shut but unbarred; something moves on the road; licences: none relevant
line: I draw my arming sword, shove the wicket open and step out to face whoever's on the road. If it turns ugly, I'm ready to fight.

context: Bridge outside Mossfield; a man stands at the parapet staring at the water; PC a soldier; licences: none relevant
line: talk to the person on the bridge

context: Same bridge; the man answered vaguely and looks away; licences: none relevant
line: press him gently

context: Hawkham, inside the walls near the gate; licences: none relevant
line: What do I know about the land around Hawkham? Then I'll head for the gate.

context: Fernhollow quay; a silent child stares into the water among other children; PC a merchant holding lic.training.influence_persuasion
line: I tap the child's shoulder lightly and say, "I'm Lisius, a merchant. If you tell me what you see down there, I'll give you a copper. Who else is about this morning, a dockhand or a harbourmaster I could talk to?"

context: Same quay; the child has not answered; PC holds lic.training.influence_persuasion
line: I gently turn the child's face toward me and say, "Hey. I'm not going anywhere. Can you hear me? Tell me your name, and what's down there in the water."

context: Same quay; the children keep their places; PC holds lic.training.influence_persuasion
line: I hold up a copper where the smallest child can see it and say, "Here. It's real. Just tell me what's down there, and I'll put it in your hand." Then I ask, "What do you know about this man Falwen?"

context: Redwick temple court; Durdun, head of Garine's faithful, wears a raven-feather token; PC a merchant; licences: none relevant
line: What do I know about the raven-feather token you wear? I lower my voice. "I'm a merchant, I hear things. If something sacred has gone missing, a buyer might turn up. Tell me what Garine's people think the niche held, and I'll tell you if anyone offers it in the market."

context: Inn table with Kerwin, who stalls; PC's sheet lists the knack 'intimidation'; licences: none relevant
line: I slam my fist on the table and loom over Kerwin. "Last chance. Name the price, or I walk and take the child's trouble with me."

context: Same inn; the child Ranwen holds a raven-feather token; Kerwin dodges; licences: none relevant
line: I grab the raven-feather token gently and stare Kerwin down. "Enough dodging. Press on the child then: who gave her that feather? And I'll take the work. What's the price?"

context: Inn doorway; Thariel, a watcher in an embroidered coat; licences: none relevant
line: I grab Thariel's embroidered collar and haul him close. "Don't lie to me. Somebody in this town knows where the Lantern Gang drinks. Tell me, or we find out how hard you are to hold."

context: Ravencrag market, a crowd presses round the well; a familiar face vanished into it; licences: none relevant
line: I look around for something here that would help me, like a cart, barrel or ledge I can climb to see over the crowd.

context: The reeve's hall; the reeve is present; licences: none relevant
line: Tell me about the prisoner in the reeve's cell.

context: Larkgate's gate; men of the watch stand by; licences: none relevant
line: ask the men at the gate what the Brockmere Lodge is

context: By the well; a young woman who has been crying; licences: none relevant
line: I ask her why she's been crying

context: Penwell shrine; Oggza the Quiet clutches her apron; a bench nearby; licences: none relevant
line: I keep my voice gentle and sit on the bench so I'm lower than her. "Forget the Wolves, then. Who are you, Oggza? And what's got you so jumpy that you're holding that apron like a shield? Is there anything I can do for you?"

context: Council yard; Ghazra Half-Ear, who evades questions about Liso; licences: none relevant
line: Press her on Liso. Ghazra, he's your kin, isn't he? He shares my surname's look and he won't turn around. What did he do?

context: Inn common room; someone sits at a bench; licences: none relevant
line: who is sitting at that bench? I describe what I can see of them without staring.

context: On the road in the High Vale; licences: none relevant
line: What do I know about the High Vale?

context: Rosie Bramblehill with a child, uneasy; licences: none relevant
line: I gently ask about the child. "Rosie, forget Rakum a moment. Is the child yours?"

context: Ravencrag market crowd; a familiar face is slipping away through it; licences: none relevant
line: I shove through the crowd after that face, chasing it hard.

context: The inn; Borin the keeper behind the counter; licences: none relevant
line: I ask him, "What can you give me, Borin? And who's that asking about me by name? Has a stranger been in here?"

context: Penwell green; Seley Coldley, a travel-worn refugee, nearby; licences: none relevant
line: I walk over to Seley Coldley and say quietly, "You look like you've walked a long way. What happened at Marlmore's Warren? I'll listen, even if no one else will."

context: Marlwall quay; a wagon with a mark on its boards; a bill on the gatepost; licences: none relevant
line: I look closely at the quay first. What does the mark on the wagon look like, and can I get close enough to read the bill on the gatepost?

context: Redford street; the Blue Bell inn across the way; licences: none relevant
line: I walk over to the Blue Bell and ask the keeper who the Greyford Circle are.

context: Any scene; licences: none relevant
line: What are my options?

context: Redford gate; carters with a split wagon; licences: none relevant
line: I turn toward the carters and ask what they saw, and whether the seam was there when they set out on the road.

context: Edge of the Hollow Heath, open moorland; licences: none relevant
line: I head out onto the Hollow Heath to explore and see what's out there.

context: Hill gate; the captain keeps a count of the sick; licences: none relevant
line: Captain, you've held that count a long time. Tell me plainly: who in the poor quarter is coughing first, and what did the healers tell you?

context: The gate; Captain Garett holds the PC's arm; Selda beyond him; licences: none relevant
line: I stamp my heel down on Garett's bad leg's foot and wrench my arm free, then lunge for Selda.

context: Swanstead notice board; PC holds lic.lang.letters
line: I stop at the notice board and read the Swanstead Company notice closely. Where do I apply, and what else is pinned up?

context: Duel with Taman Brightfield on the hall floor; PC holds two daggers; licences: none relevant
line: I keep the off-hand dagger up between us and press in again, going for his ribs.

context: Inn; Edda is talking; a scarred woman listens nearby; licences: none relevant
line: I let Edda finish first, then turn to the scarred woman. Who is she, and what does she want?

context: Tavern; a halfling just left into the rain; Milly at the table; licences: none relevant
line: I follow the halfling out into the rain, but I leave my cup on the table so Milly knows I'm coming back.

context: Marlwell street near the gate; licences: none relevant
line: turn back toward the gate

context: Chapel door marked with a chalk cult symbol; nobody about; licences: none relevant
line: I crouch by the door and touch the chalk lightly with a fingertip to see if it smears. Then I copy the symbol into my writing case on parchment.

context: Gate arch; Marard Blackfield, the gate captain; licences: none relevant
line: I talk to Marard Blackfield, the gate captain.

context: Under the arch with Belo de Belay; licences: none relevant
line: I ask him what the captain said about Maro. What were his exact words?

context: Inn table; Kerwin hints at danger on the levee; licences: none relevant
line: I press him on the levee. What will it ask of me, and what's the danger out there?

context: Penwell shrine; Oggza the Quiet; licences: none relevant
line: I lean forward a little and say, "You mentioned the dead, or I did. Who did you lose, Oggza? Tell me their names, and I'll remember them."

context: The ford; licences: none relevant
line: What do I know about Tikka Mud-Walker? And what are my options?

context: Fernhollow quay; a notice at the gangway post; children nearby; PC holds lic.lang.letters
line: I read the notice at the foot of the gangway post out loud to the children, then ask, "What does this notice say? Has anyone here been told to stay away from the water?"

context: Larkhollow market square; someone is missing; licences: none relevant
line: What can I see from here? Is there anyone I could ask about the missing person?

context: Larkwick barbican; Tikash of the watch; a bill the PC cannot read; licences: none relevant
line: I rest a moment against the barbican wall, then ask Tikash plainly: "Where can I find a scribe or a priest in Larkwick who'd read me that bill?"

context: Larkgate street; a woman who knows about hiring; licences: none relevant
line: I shove her against the gatepost and growl, "Who's hiring for Larkgate, and where do I find them? Talk."

context: Same street; the woman tries to call out; licences: none relevant
line: I stop her. I clamp a hand over her mouth and drag her behind the plank stack, away from the street. "Quiet. One more chance. Who hires for Larkgate?"

context: Workshop; Valius holds a carpenter's plane; licences: none relevant
line: I snatch the plane out of Valius's hands and ask him again, loudly, whether he's scared of carts.

context: A notice on an alder post; PC does not hold lic.lang.letters
line: I look closely at the notice on the alder post and read what it says.

context: Inn doorway with a notice; PC holds lic.lang.letters
line: I read the notice by the door

context: Selda stands on a step above the PC, turning away; licences: none relevant
line: I grab Selda's boot and look up at him. "Selda, it's me. Hear me out, one minute, then do what you like."

context: Gate post; the PC already grips Captain Vesian's arm; licences: none relevant
line: I keep my grip on his arm and say low and hard: "Now, Vesian. The name. Who's missing, and who saw them last?"

context: Duel with Taman; he offers to stop; licences: none relevant
line: I refuse his half-help and slash at him again. I'm not backing down.

context: Ravencrag market crowd; the PC was knocked to one knee; licences: none relevant
line: I drag myself up off the knee and keep pushing through the crowd toward that strip of grey roof and the figure beyond it.

context: Crowded gate approach; carts stopped in the press; licences: none relevant
line: I shove harder, shoulder first, and shout "Make way, guard coming through!" while climbing onto a cart to see the gate.

context: Redwick market; a stallholder who knows something about the theft; PC holds lic.training.influence_trade
line: I press him for his price. I'm a merchant, so I offer him a few coins for what he knows. I ask him what he wants for the name of the thief, or at least what was taken.

context: Library steps with a nervous scholar; licences: none relevant
line: I wait quietly with him, then ask: "Did I hear right? Is it the book you want, or what's in it?"

context: Larkgate notice board; licences: none relevant
line: I stay here at the board. What do I know about the Brockmere Lodge?

context: A guard blocks the hall door; licences: none relevant
line: I shove past the guard into the hall.

context: A guard blocks the hall door; licences: none relevant
line: I don't shove, I squeeze past the guard into the hall.

context: A clerk holds the town ledger; licences: none relevant
line: I grab the ledger out of the clerk's hands.

context: A clerk holds the town ledger; licences: none relevant
line: I don't grab it. I hold out my hand and ask the clerk to give me the ledger.

context: A smuggler crowds the PC on the jetty; licences: none relevant
line: I hit the smuggler across the jaw.

context: A smuggler crowds the PC on the jetty; licences: none relevant
line: I don't hit him. I tell the smuggler to back off.

context: Inn; the innkeeper is wary of questions; licences: none relevant
line: I threaten the innkeeper until she tells me who rented the back room.

context: Inn; the innkeeper is wary of questions; licences: none relevant
line: I don't threaten her, I just ask the innkeeper who rented the back room.

context: A locked cellar door; licences: none relevant
line: I pick the lock on the cellar door.

context: A locked cellar door; licences: none relevant
line: I don't pick the lock. I knock on the cellar door and wait.

context: A cold, empty chapel said to be haunted; licences: none relevant
line: I use my witch-sight to see the spirits in the room.

context: A cold, empty chapel said to be haunted; licences: none relevant
line: I don't use any witch-sight, I just look around the room with my own eyes.

context: Sentries watch the north gate at night; licences: none relevant
line: I sneak past the sentries at the gate.

context: Sentries watch the north gate at night; licences: none relevant
line: I don't sneak. I walk openly past the sentries at the gate.

context: A frightened boy holds a knife; licences: none relevant
line: I wrestle the knife from the boy's hand.

context: A frightened boy holds a knife; licences: none relevant
line: I don't wrestle it from him; I ask the boy to hand me the knife.

context: An old man stands in a doorway; licences: none relevant
line: I push the old man aside and step through the door.

context: An old man stands in a doorway; licences: none relevant
line: I don't push him. I wait for the old man to step aside, then go through the door.

context: Guardroom; the guard's cup sits by his elbow; licences: none relevant
line: I pour the sleeping draught into the guard's cup when he looks away.

context: Guardroom; the guard's cup sits by his elbow; licences: none relevant
line: I don't drug him. I pour the guard a cup of ale and offer it to him.

context: A guard answers the PC's questions at the gate; licences: none relevant
line: I read the guard's surface thoughts with my mind-touch.

context: A guard answers the PC's questions at the gate; licences: none relevant
line: I don't use any mind-touch; I just watch the guard's face for a lie.

context: Crossroads outside town; licences: none relevant
line: Where does the north road lead?

context: Smithy; the smith is at her anvil; licences: none relevant
line: I ask the smith where the missing girl was last seen.

context: Inn; the innkeeper wipes the bar; licences: none relevant
line: "Who around here would know about the old mill?" I ask the innkeeper.

context: A cloaked stranger has followed the PC all day; licences: none relevant
line: "What do you want from me?" I ask the stranger.

context: Home village green; PC grew up here; licences: none relevant
line: I try to remember what my village said about the wound in the sky.

context: A cold river ford in spate; licences: none relevant
line: I swim across the ford to the far bank.

context: A courtyard; town guards are searching for the PC; licences: none relevant
line: I hide behind the stacked barrels.

context: Town wall, a patrol passes every few minutes; licences: none relevant
line: I climb the wall to get a better look at the road.
